sourceEvidence: Actual Admin DEV Chrome: 192 shoppers for Cinepolis, but recertification selector shows a first-forty hard limit; QA identity Shopper I3.8 DEV Validation exists and is absent from the selector. Exact code app/modules/cert.js used .slice(0,40) and an option list with a preselected real person.
expected: Admin can select any visible shopper in the current project by explicit choice, including QA-only shoppers, without cross-project acceptance, duplicate IDs or automatic selection; requests are written only with provider ACK.
